status: FROZEN. Written after (a) expert_source_feasibility.place_container_plate.v1.json, (b) protocol.t2_eval_census.v1.json and its 200×8 census, and (c) t2_eval_panels.place_container_plate.v1.json identifiability PASS. Pre-freeze draft remains protocol.t2_training.v1.DRAFT.json as a historical snapshot and must not be used as the training protocol. Binding numbers below may not be weakened after this freeze.

protocol.t2_expert_audit.v1.json.role: audit protocol; its t2_design_commitments are inherited for Q=12 primary contrasts

protocol.t2_eval_census.v1.json.role: independent 200×8 π₀ census; sole source of primary E/M/H eval panels

expert_source_feasibility.place_containe.role: feasible set; per-seed expert trajectories entering pool D_X

t2_selection.place_container_plate.v1.js.role: frozen arm compositions (Cover/Random/Self-Diverse) and dose points

protocol.t1d.v1.1.json.role: matched-training rules inherited: S_star rule, dose semantics, per-sample overuse bound, frozen Base200 600.ckpt initialization

t2_eval_panels.place_container_plate.v1..role: frozen independent E/M/H and within/cross-cell hard panels; identifiable=true

frozen_probe_facts.note: Do not reopen probe or selection. Paper must state Cover-12 is fallback-completed slot selection, not coverage of 12 live cells.

training_points.total_runs: 6 points × K=12 paired training seeds = 72 matched small-dose jobs

arm_definitions.Zero: zero-dose optimizer-only point: same S_star gradient steps on the frozen Base200 mixture with rho = 0 new data. Identical to the T1d zero-dose semantics.
arm_definitions.Self-Diverse-12: 12 T1c D_H self-trajectories chosen by the frozen round-robin diversity rule in select_cover12.py (distinct successful seeds ascending, then attempt_index ascending). Controls for 'any 12 hard-seed trajectories' vs expert provenance.
arm_definitions.Expert-Random-12: 12 expert trajectories uniform without replacement from the feasible set, random.Random(20260818). Descriptive control only; no confirmatory cover > random claim (see contrasts.precommitted_exclusions).
arm_definitions.Expert-Cover-6: first 6 slots of Expert-Cover-12 in frozen cell order at Q=6 dose.
arm_definitions.Expert-Cover-12: the fallback-completed cell-covering selection from the frozen rule; 7/12 slots filled via fallback; only 5 distinct occupied source cells.
arm_definitions.Expert-Cover-20: Expert-Cover-12 plus the next 8 feasible seeds from the frozen global ranking. Trains ONLY the 20 expert trajectories + Base200 rehearsal; does NOT mix in the 41 T1c D_H self trajectories.

6.allowed_claims: dose-curve trend only; below ESS rescue line; not a primary inference point

12.allowed_claims: Cover vs Zero and Cover vs Self-Diverse confirmatory contrasts; MUST NOT be labeled ESS rescue (realized n_eff=9.33 < 10)

20.allowed_claims: Pareto-safe learnability claim ONLY via Gamma_20 rescue gate; acquisition-stage n_eff=12.04 documents source-pool support, NOT the trained mixture

primary_q12_inference.estimand: paired per-training-seed difference D_k on the independent hard panel from t2_eval_panels
primary_q12_inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two primary Q=12 contrasts

rescue_q20.definition: Gamma_20 = min{Delta_H^20 - 0.05, Delta_E^20 + 0.05, Delta_M^20 + 0.05} on the independent census panels
rescue_q20.claim_rule: The phrase 'targeted expert trajectories restored Pareto-safe learnability' is allowed ONLY if LCB_95%(Gamma_20) > 0
rescue_q20.independence_from_q12: Gamma_20 is a separate rescue gate; Q=12 primary contrasts remain binding regardless of Gamma_20 outcome

secondary_descriptive: Expert-Cover-12 vs Expert-Random-12 at Q=12 — descriptive only
precommitted_exclusions: T2 makes NO confirmatory cover > random claim. Random-12 is retained as a descriptive control because Cover-12 and Random-12 share 7/12 seeds and geometric separation is too small for a powered mechanism contrast.

exposure.reporting: BOTH w_source and w_traj reported for every arm in the run report; w_traj is the binding constraint.
exposure.dose_comparison_note: Q=12 and Q=20 share rho=0.15 (fixed total dose); they differ in trajectory count and per-trajectory repetition (w_traj 2.94 vs 1.76). Q=6 lowers rho to satisfy w_traj<=3; the three points do NOT match per-trajectory exposure.

dose_curve.q6_rule: first 6 slots of Expert-Cover-12 in frozen cell order; exploratory exposure-capped point only
dose_curve.q20_rule: Cover-12 + next 8 feasible seeds from the frozen global ranking; status ACTIVE (25 feasible >= 20)

rho_at_each_q.6: rho_q6 = 3*6/(200+3*6) = 0.0826 chosen so w_traj = 3 (exposure-capped exploratory point; total dose lower than Q=12/Q=20)
rho_at_each_q.20: rho = 0.15, w_traj = 1.76; compares coverage count at fixed total dose vs Q=12, NOT matched per-trajectory exposure

ess_labeling.acquisition_stage: n_eff computed over (41 T1c D_H self successes + Q expert trajectories, one per new seed) with prior-success penalty at selection time
ess_labeling.q12: realized n_eff = 9.33 — NOT labeled ESS rescue
ess_labeling.q20: realized n_eff = 12.04 — ONLY point labeled acquisition-stage ESS rescue
ess_labeling.training_stage: Expert-Cover-20 trains 20 expert trajs + Base200 only; do NOT write 'we trained an ESS=12.04 combined pool'. Hybrid-20 = D_H41 + D_X20 requires a separate future protocol.

paired_training.rule: all six training points share IDENTICAL K training RNG seeds; inference on per-seed differences D_k = J_arm(k) - J_ref(k)
paired_training.seed_kind: dp_training_rng_seeds (Hydra training.seed); NOT environment seeds and NOT the 100500–100699 census pool
paired_training.K_rationale: Frozen directly without T1d variance estimation: place never entered T1d (no t1d_launch_config.json); legacy BRACE training-seed evidence is motivation-only per t0_audit.json and must not enter the T1+ chain.

matched_training.inherit: protocol.t1d.v1.1 matched_training_rule verbatim: same S_star, batch size, LR schedule, optimizer, initialization (frozen Base200 600.ckpt) for every point including Zero
matched_training.dose_semantics: rho is a sampling proportion at fixed S_star; remainder of each batch is the frozen Base200 rehearsal set; never dataset-size or step-count changes
matched_training.s_base200_source: No Base200 logs.json.txt exists on disk. S_base200 is the materialized optimizer step count stored in 600.ckpt pickles.global_step (epoch 599 of num_epochs 600).
matched_training.initialization: training.resume_from_ckpt = policy/DP/checkpoints/place_container_plate-demo_clean-200-0/600.ckpt; load weights only (exclude optimizer); reset global_step=0 and epoch=0 before the S_star budget

evaluation.main_metrics: Delta_H, Delta_E, Delta_M computed ONLY on the independent census panels; Gamma_12 contrasts use independent hard panel; Gamma_20 uses independent E/M/H panels
evaluation.memorization_diagnostic: original 50 T1b hard seeds (difficulty_groups.place_container_plate.v1.json); reported separately; EXCLUDED from primary Delta_H and both Gamma gates
evaluation.eval_seed_to_cell_main: from t2_eval_panels seed records (census-derived cell map)
evaluation.delta_h_split: within-cell vs cross-cell decomposition on the independent hard panel using the five Cover-12 occupied source cells frozen in t2_selection / protocol.t2_eval_census.v1.json

interpretation_table.within_only: gain concentrated on within-cell eval seeds, cross-cell ~ 0: capability transport is LOCAL — targeted acquisition works but claims must be cell-scoped
interpretation_table.within_plus_related: within-cell gain plus attenuated gain on related cells: GRADED transport along the frozen cell metric
interpretation_table.broad: comparable within- and cross-cell gain: transport is GLOBAL; coverage design was sufficient but not necessary at this Q
interpretation_table.train_seed_only: gain only on memorization-diagnostic seeds or training-adjacent overlap: MEMORIZATION, not capability transport

eval_protocol.policy_seed_rule: policy_seed = 8000 + repeat (repeat in 0..7); disjoint from T1b 5000, T1c 6000, and census 7000
eval_protocol.seed_lists: copied from t2_eval_panels.place_container_plate.v1.json panels.easy / medium / hard (and within_cell_hard / cross_cell_hard splits). Memorization diagnostic uses groups.hard from difficulty_groups.place_container_plate.v1.json.

language.zero_success_seeds: 'empirically unsupported' / 'not harvestable under the frozen budget' with one-sided p_upper = 1 - 0.05^(1/n); never 'impossible'
language.cover12_description: Cover-12 is a fallback-completed 12-slot selection under policy support and expert feasibility constraints; it is NOT coverage of 12 distinct feasible capability cells
language.claims_scope: no semantic-skill claims; cells are geometry strata, transport claims are stratum-scoped

launch_config: experiments/capability_transport/t2_launch_config.json — frozen before the first arm trains

explicit_rejections.no_reordering: cells, rankings, fallback orders, and arm compositions may not change after the probe output exists; any edit voids the T2 preregistration
explicit_rejections.no_cap_rescue: if Cover-12 is infeasible, T2 does not launch under this design; no attempt-cap increases or re-probes
explicit_rejections.no_unpaired_inference: aggregate success-rate comparisons across arms without seed pairing are exploratory only
explicit_rejections.no_t1d_variance_for_K: K is frozen at 12 without reference to T1d D_k variance or legacy BRACE training-seed outcomes
explicit_rejections.no_confirmatory_cover_gt_random: precommitted; resolves audit secondary-contrast power requirement by exclusion, not by editing the frozen audit protocol
explicit_rejections.no_hybrid20_in_this_t2: Expert-Cover-20 does not train D_H41 + D_X20; Hybrid-20 is out of scope
